description: This is an HTML source file that defines the user interface for a web-based database visualizer. It includes HTML structure, CSS styles, and JavaScript code to fetch, display, and interact with database lists, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles expansion of database to show its tables and loads tables if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data from a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the fetched data into an HTML table with headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell values, handling special formatting for objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncated preview.
